275 other ages/periods and 30 body transformations are represented by separate fighter UIDs and never removed from the roster.
No source PNG pixels, atlas geometry, machine rig or fighter stat changed by this policy.
Old derived Archives source implementations and their original files are retained; no new native retro art is claimed.

Independent native retro artwork must have its own atlas files, independently drawn facings and verified art metadata; the style-reinterpretation provenance keeps canonical identity and original art separated.
